Guard.trigger: a player has claimed the Seer role
Guard.rationale_short: Failing to protect the Seer after they claimed their role.

Witch.trigger: target is already protected by the Guard
Witch.rationale_short: used a SAVE potion on yourself (redundant since the Guard protected you)

Witch.trigger: target is a claiming Power Role without a mechanical contradiction
Witch.rationale_short: Never poison a claiming Power Role without a mechanical contradiction.

Villager.trigger: a player has been cleared by the Seer
Villager.rationale_short: treat the Seer and their cleared targets as an untouchable unit

Villager.trigger: an attack is made on the Confirmed Core without a counter-claim
Villager.rationale_short: Any attack on the Core without a counter-claim is a high-probability Wolf signal.

Villager.trigger: evaluating a player's role or guilt
Villager.rationale_short: Stop using terms like 'suspicious' or 'erratic'; demand mechanical proof: 'What role are you, and what evidence do you have?'
